##### SECTION M2 (stale resume tokens (incremental source destroyed, target destroyed/recreated, sender renamed))  tag=C  zfs-2.2.2-0ubuntu9.5
=== CASE M2/i_from_destroyed.0a_base

--- stderr
=== END

--- cmd
